tithi.name: Dwitiya
tithi.description: Favorable for auspicious beginnings, stable ventures, and establishing enduring foundations.

Mesha.summary: Exalted Moon in your second house enhances financial clarity and family bonding.
Mesha.general: Your words carry persuasive charm and emotional depth today, aiding complex discussions. Trust your intuition when resolving longstanding household matters.
Mesha.career: Negotiations and presentations will turn strongly in your favor due to confident articulation. Maintain transparency with team members to gain their full cooperation.
Mesha.finance: Financial gains through past investments or family resources are indicated. Avoid impulsive retail purchases despite strong liquidity.
Mesha.relationships: Sweetness in speech helps heal past misunderstandings with your partner. An elder relative offers comforting guidance this evening.
Mesha.health: Vocal cords and throat require gentle care against cold drafts. Keep yourself hydrated and consume warm herbal tea.
Mesha.remedy: Chant the Mangal Gayatri Mantra and offer sweet jaggery to a cow.

Vrishabha.summary: Moon exalted in your first house brings mental clarity, creative radiance, and emotional balance.
Vrishabha.general: You exude serenity and magnetic charm that easily attracts helpful allies and opportunities. Prioritize self-development and creative endeavors today.
Vrishabha.career: Leadership initiatives undertaken today will yield fruitful long-term recognition. Superiors will appreciate your structured and aesthetic presentation style.
Vrishabha.finance: Stability marks your finances, with prospects for strategic long-term planning. Expenditure on personal grooming or quality living spaces is likely.
Vrishabha.relationships: Romance flourishes as your compassionate nature makes your partner feel cherished. Singles might attract someone who values elegance and stability.
Vrishabha.health: Vitality is elevated, leaving you feeling mentally refreshed and vibrant. Gentle yoga or mindful breathing will sustain this inner equilibrium.
Vrishabha.remedy: Apply a spot of white sandalwood paste on your forehead after your morning prayer.

Mithuna.summary: Moon in the twelfth house encourages restful introspection and disciplined budgeting.
Mithuna.general: A quieter pace allows you to recharge mental energies and analyze future strategies. Direct your focus inward through meditation or creative solitude.
Mithuna.career: Behind-the-scenes work and foreign-related assignments proceed without hindrance. Steer clear of office gossip and concentrate solely on your designated tasks.
Mithuna.finance: Unplanned expenses regarding healthcare, travel, or charity may arise today. Keep a vigilant eye on discretionary spending.
Mithuna.relationships: You may crave solitude, so communicate your need for personal space gently to your partner. Compassionate listening will prevent unwarranted domestic friction.
Mithuna.health: Prioritize quality sleep to counter mild mental fatigue and eye strain. Reduce screen exposure at least one hour before bed.
Mithuna.remedy: Donate green vegetables or feed soaked green gram to birds.

Karka.summary: Moon transiting your eleventh house delivers social joy, professional gains, and wish fulfillment.
Karka.general: Expect productive interactions that expand your professional and personal networks significantly. Your benevolent aura wins the goodwill of friends and mentors.
Karka.career: Collaborative ventures and group projects will achieve critical milestones smoothly. Your strategic suggestions will earn high praise from key decision-makers.
Karka.finance: Multiple avenues for incremental income or pending arrears may materialize today. It is an auspicious day to map out future investment portfolios.
Karka.relationships: Meaningful conversations strengthen bonds with close friends and your significant other. An evening gathering brings heartwarming emotional fulfillment.
Karka.health: High vitality and enthusiastic mood keep physical fatigue at bay. Continue maintaining a balanced, nutrient-dense diet.
Karka.remedy: Offer pure water with raw milk and white flowers to the Shiva Lingam.

Simha.summary: Tenth house transit of an exalted Moon highlights career advancement and public reputation.
Simha.general: Professional authority and determination will guide your actions toward noteworthy accomplishments. Others will readily look to you for direction and stability.
Simha.career: Executive decisions made today will bring enduring benefits and praise from higher-ups. An important project finds its rhythm through your steady management.
Simha.finance: Financial gains through professional competence or government dealings are favored. Avoid speculative risks and stick to proven asset classes.
Simha.relationships: Balancing hectic professional demands with family expectations will require conscious effort. Dedicate quality evening time to reassure your family of your devotion.
Simha.health: Pay attention to your posture and joint health during long working hours. Regular stretching breaks will maintain physical flexibility.
Simha.remedy: Offer Arghya (water) mixed with red sandalwood and Kumkum to the rising Sun.

Kanya.summary: Moon in your ninth house activates fortune, spiritual growth, and expansive new perspectives.
Kanya.general: A philosophical outlook helps you navigate daily tasks with ease and serene optimism. Intellectual pursuits, writing, and spiritual study yield immense satisfaction.
Kanya.career: Guidance from a mentor or senior colleague unlocks solutions to complex administrative roadblocks. Favorable conditions favor legal, publishing, or higher educational endeavors.
Kanya.finance: Financial fortune favors ethical dealings and calculated long-term commitments. A modest expenditure on spiritual literature or charitable causes brings inner peace.
Kanya.relationships: Shared spiritual or intellectual values deepen the emotional bond with your spouse. Harmony prevails in conversations with elders and teachers.
Kanya.health: General well-being remains strong, supported by an uplifted, stress-free mindset. Outdoor walks in natural surroundings will revitalize your physical energy.
Kanya.remedy: Chant the Gayatri Mantra 27 times and respect your teachers or spiritual preceptors.

Tula.summary: Moon in the eighth house invites mindful caution, emotional resilience, and deep research.
Tula.general: Unexpected emotional surges may test your composure; respond with patience rather than reaction. Channel your energy into investigative study, esoteric research, or auditing.
Tula.career: Avoid taking unverified shortcuts or engaging in boardroom politics today. Stick to meticulous documentation to keep professional obligations strictly clear.
Tula.finance: Joint finances, taxes, or insurance policies require cautious scrutiny. Defer speculative trading and high-stake borrowing for another day.
Tula.relationships: Hidden emotions may surface, requiring vulnerable and truthful communication with your partner. Practice empathy and avoid bringing up unresolved past grievances.
Tula.health: Take care of digestive health by avoiding heavy, oily, or unseasonal foods. Ample hydration and conscious relaxation techniques are highly advised.
Tula.remedy: Recite the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra 11 times for peace of mind and protection.

Vrischika.summary: Exalted Moon in the seventh house illuminates partnerships, marital sweetness, and fruitful alliances.
Vrischika.general: A harmonious transit encourages mutual cooperation and successful interpersonal negotiations. Your magnetism helps convert skeptics into enthusiastic supporters.
Vrischika.career: Business partnerships and client relationships operate smoothly with mutual trust. A collective team effort produces far better results than individual struggle today.
Vrischika.finance: Financial collaboration and contract signings carry positive long-term momentum. Gains from spouse or shared business initiatives are well indicated.
Vrischika.relationships: Marital life sparkles with mutual understanding, emotional closeness, and pleasant gestures. Unmarried natives may receive delightful relationship prospects.
Vrischika.health: Overall vitality is sound, though keeping your kidneys and lower abdomen hydrated is essential. Light evening recreation helps maintain a joyful state.
Vrischika.remedy: Offer fragrance or white flowers to Goddess Lakshmi for harmony in relationships.

Dhanu.summary: Sixth house transit sharpens your competitive edge, service orientation, and problem-solving skills.
Dhanu.general: Your systematic approach dissolves pending obstacles and overcomes rival opposition easily. Tackle demanding responsibilities with confident poise and discipline.
Dhanu.career: Daily workflow will be highly efficient as your attention to detail catches errors early. Subordinates and coworkers willingly assist in completing urgent tasks.
Dhanu.finance: A good day for clearing existing debts, consolidating budgets, or recovering disputed funds. Exercise prudent moderation when planning luxury expenses.
Dhanu.relationships: Avoid turning minor domestic differences into debates over perfectionism. Sincere support during everyday chores will speak louder than grand romantic declarations.
Dhanu.health: Your stamina is robust, making this an excellent day to recommit to clean eating and fitness. Guard against seasonal allergies through wholesome home-cooked meals.
Dhanu.remedy: Apply a subtle tilak of saffron or turmeric and recite the Hanuman Chalisa.

Makara.summary: Moon in your fifth house awakens artistic creativity, intellectual wisdom, and romantic warmth.
Makara.general: Your mental faculties are exceptionally sharp, promoting creative innovation and thoughtful problem resolution. Devote time to academic pursuits, strategic hobbies, or guiding the young.
Makara.career: Creative projects receive enthusiastic approval from mentors and senior stakeholders. Your ability to think outside conventional boundaries sets your work apart.
Makara.finance: Speculative insights are well-grounded, but prudent diversification remains paramount. Income through creative ventures or advisory roles may see an upward trend.
Makara.relationships: Romantic ties are deeply enriched through playful banter and emotional sincerity. Joyful news regarding children or family expansion warms your heart.
Makara.health: Mental cheerfulness fosters excellent physical well-being and consistent energy levels. Engage in a stimulating creative pastime to keep stress at bay.
Makara.remedy: Light a sesame oil lamp in the evening and feed black sesame seeds to ants.

Kumbha.summary: Exalted Moon in the fourth house delivers domestic bliss, inner contentment, and property gains.
Kumbha.general: A soothing sense of peace anchors your heart, making home life comforting and rewarding. Focus on stabilizing your living environment and nurturing emotional well-being.
Kumbha.career: Working from a comfortable environment or handling real estate and resource management yields success. Maintain a calm, unhurried demeanor when resolving team discrepancies.
Kumbha.finance: Investments in home decor, vehicle maintenance, or real property are auspiciously timed. Financial security feels assured as domestic savings remain stable.
Kumbha.relationships: Your mother or maternal figures offer immense emotional comfort and sage blessings today. Heart-to-heart exchanges at home strengthen your core relationships.
Kumbha.health: Chest and emotional comfort are well-aligned, provided you do not internalize transient worries. Practice deep pranayama to enhance respiratory vitality.
Kumbha.remedy: Offer a bowl of milk to stray animals or serve water to thirsty individuals.

Meena.summary: Third house transit bolsters inner courage, networking abilities, and short travel initiatives.
Meena.general: Your natural empathy pairs with proactive determination, empowering you to initiate bold ventures. Communication across all mediums flows smoothly and productively.
Meena.career: Marketing campaigns, writing projects, and short business trips yield promising returns. Co-workers and younger colleagues look up to your creative leadership.
Meena.finance: Modest short-term gains through communicative skills or freelance opportunities are indicated. Budget carefully for travel or communication gadgets.
Meena.relationships: Bonds with younger siblings or close neighbors grow significantly warmer and more supportive. An unexpected message brings cheerful warmth to your romantic life.
Meena.health: Stamina and physical enthusiasm remain elevated throughout the waking hours. Avoid physical strain on your shoulders and arms through gentle posture corrections.
Meena.remedy: Offer yellow flowers to Lord Vishnu and recite 'Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya'.

tithi.name: Krishna Tritiya
tithi.description: Favorable for creative endeavors, domestic bonding, and worshipping Lord Ganesha and Goddess Gauri.

Mesha.summary: Financial stability strengthens as family matters take center stage today.
Mesha.general: Your words carry persuasive charm, helping you resolve long-standing domestic misunderstandings. Focus on organizing your personal assets and valuing close kin.
Mesha.career: Collaborative meetings yield constructive results, especially in trade or client relations. Maintain a courteous tone when negotiating with superiors.
Mesha.finance: A steady inflow of funds brings peace of mind and allows planned savings. Avoid impulsive luxury expenses during the afternoon.
Mesha.relationships: Warmth defines your interactions with family members and your spouse. An honest conversation deepens emotional trust.
Mesha.health: Oral and throat hygiene need mild attention today. Stay hydrated and avoid excessively spicy foods.
Mesha.remedy: Offer fresh green grass or spinach to a cow in the morning.

Vrishabha.summary: The exalted Moon in your sign grants clarity, magnetism, and emotional vitality.
Vrishabha.general: You radiate poise and self-assurance, drawing supportive people into your sphere. Channel this serene energy into your primary personal goals.
Vrishabha.career: Leadership qualities shine brightly, making it an excellent day to present original ideas. Colleagues will readily look to you for direction.
Vrishabha.finance: Monetary prospects look balanced and supportive of long-term investments. Good judgment prevails in business transactions.
Vrishabha.relationships: Spousal affection and mutual appreciation reach an uplifting high. Single natives may find someone captivated by their gracious nature.
Vrishabha.health: Vitality is robust, providing mental lightness and physical ease. Enjoy a peaceful evening walk to ground your thoughts.
Vrishabha.remedy: Chant the Chandra Beej Mantra 'Om Shram Shreem Shroum Sah Chandraya Namah' 11 times.

Mithuna.summary: A day for mindful spending, spiritual rejuvenation, and purposeful quietude.
Mithuna.general: The 12th house transit invites you to step back from bustling routines and reflect. Cultivate patience as subtle inner shifts prepare you for future gains.
Mithuna.career: Overseas projects, remote assignments, and research work progress smoothly. Guard against distractions and double-check important paperwork.
Mithuna.finance: Unplanned expenditures regarding wellness or home needs may arise. Stick to a predetermined budget to avoid unnecessary strain.
Mithuna.relationships: Give partners adequate emotional space to prevent minor friction. Compassionate listening will resolve unspoken anxieties.
Mithuna.health: Ensure adequate sleep to prevent eye strain and mental exhaustion. Gentle meditation before bedtime will prove very beneficial.
Mithuna.remedy: Donate green moong dal or feed birds soaked grains.

Karka.summary: Substantial gains and warm camaraderie uplift your spirits throughout the day.
Karka.general: Your sign lord transiting the 11th house activates auspicious networks and fulfilled ambitions. Enjoy the company of loyal friends and celebrate progress.
Karka.career: Team ventures yield notable breakthroughs, earning praise from senior executives. Your intuitive approach to problem-solving wins appreciation.
Karka.finance: Multiple avenues of incremental gains open up, improving cash flow. Past investments demonstrate encouraging and fruitful returns.
Karka.relationships: Social gatherings and romantic bonds bring tremendous joy and heartfelt comfort. A friend may offer meaningful advice on an intimate matter.
Karka.health: General energy remains vibrant, though calves or ankles might feel slightly tired. Hydrate adequately throughout your active routine.
Karka.remedy: Offer raw milk mixed with water and white flowers to a Shiva Lingam.

Simha.summary: Professional authority elevates as your efforts gain well-deserved recognition.
Simha.general: The karmic 10th house transit highlights your dignity, discipline, and execution power. Take bold strides toward your most ambitious career milestones.
Simha.career: New responsibilities showcase your executive capabilities to top management. Your strategic vision helps clear an ongoing organizational bottleneck.
Simha.finance: Financial rewards linked to professional performance or commissions look bright. It is an auspicious time to plan commercial expansions.
Simha.relationships: Balancing long working hours with domestic duties is key to harmony. Reassure loved ones with quality attention in the evening.
Simha.health: Physical endurance is solid, though posture-related back tightness could occur. Practice gentle spinal stretches during workday breaks.
Simha.remedy: Offer Arghya (water) mixed with red sandalwood powder to the rising Sun.

Kanya.summary: Fortune smiles on creative ventures, ethical endeavors, and spiritual growth.
Kanya.general: The 9th house transit enlivens your optimism, intuition, and quest for wisdom. Obstacles melt away as fortunate coincidences guide your path.
Kanya.career: Collaborations with mentors, advisors, or distant clients show remarkable progress. Academic, legal, and publishing initiatives receive strong momentum.
Kanya.finance: Financial fortune is favored, making this a promising day for long-term ventures. Charitable acts will bring unseen divine grace and security.
Kanya.relationships: Shared philosophical values foster deeper romantic and familial intimacy. A pilgrim trip or cultural outing with family brings contentment.
Kanya.health: Mental serenity promotes robust physical well-being and high vitality. Outdoor breathing exercises will enhance your mental sharpness.
Kanya.remedy: Apply a chandan (sandalwood) tilak on your forehead before leaving home.

Tula.summary: Practice emotional moderation and careful planning to navigate subtle shifts.
Tula.general: The 8th house transit calls for introspective balance, discretion, and emotional resilience. Avoid taking unnecessary speculative risks today.
Tula.career: Focus on routine duties and meticulous research rather than launching major pitches. Keep confidential work securely guarded from casual scrutiny.
Tula.finance: Joint finances, taxes, or inheritance matters need careful perusal. Refrain from lending money or signing hasty financial agreements.
Tula.relationships: Unresolved emotional undercurrents may surface; respond with compassion rather than defense. Deep intimacy is possible through vulnerability.
Tula.health: Digestive equilibrium and emotional calm should be your primary wellness priorities. Light, freshly prepared meals will keep you balanced.
Tula.remedy: Chant the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra 3 times for peace and protection.

Vrischika.summary: Partnerships flourish with mutual empathy, understanding, and shared goals.
Vrischika.general: The 7th house transit across your sign illuminates public relations and intimate bonds. Cooperation proves significantly more fruitful than solo efforts.
Vrischika.career: Joint ventures and client negotiations proceed with productive ease. Your diplomatic attitude helps win over tough stakeholders.
Vrischika.finance: Financial negotiations through partnerships yield solid ground for future profit. A fair contractual agreement can be finalized today.
Vrischika.relationships: Marital bliss and romantic harmony receive an exquisite celestial boost. Express your appreciation to your partner through small, thoughtful gestures.
Vrischika.health: Hydration and kidney health should be supported with ample pure water. Moderate evening exercise will help release accumulated stress.
Vrischika.remedy: Light a pure ghee lamp in front of Goddess Lakshmi in the evening.

Dhanu.summary: Determination turns hurdles into stepping stones for triumph and productivity.
Dhanu.general: The 6th house transit sharpens your analytical skills, work ethic, and resilience. You have the energetic upper hand in overcoming any daily challenges.
Dhanu.career: Efficiency at work earns commendation from peers and supervisors alike. Outstanding tasks are completed ahead of schedule with neat accuracy.
Dhanu.finance: Expenses are effectively regulated through practical budgeting. A favorable resolution in a disputed dues matter brings relief.
Dhanu.relationships: Keep interactions straightforward to avoid unnecessary semantic misunderstandings. Offer practical help to a partner who may be feeling overwhelmed.
Dhanu.health: Pay attention to digestive rhythm and gut flora by eating fiber-rich food. Avoid overworking your muscles during physical training.
Dhanu.remedy: Feed a stray dog or offer bread to animals with reverence.

Makara.summary: Inspiration, creative intelligence, and joy brighten your personal horizon.
Makara.general: The 5th house transit unleashes creative intellect, refined judgment, and playful optimism. Trust your instincts in artistic and intellectual matters.
Makara.career: Innovative solutions flow naturally, impressing collaborators and decision-makers. Students and professionals in advisory roles experience excellent productivity.
Makara.finance: Calculated investments and analytical decisions yield positive expectations. Avoid emotional spending on fleeting amusements.
Makara.relationships: Romance blossoms with sweet affection and spontaneous fun. Parents will experience heart-warming moments with their children.
Makara.health: Mental joy uplifts physical energy, keeping sluggishness at bay. Engage in artistic hobbies to refresh your mental faculties.
Makara.remedy: Recite the Saraswati Vandana or chant 'Om Aim Saraswatyai Namah'.

Kumbha.summary: Domestic harmony and inner grounding provide comfort amidst busy schedules.
Kumbha.general: The 4th house transit urges you to nourish your roots, family life, and emotional base. Peace of mind is best preserved through domestic serenity.
Kumbha.career: Handle professional duties methodically without letting home concerns distract you. Remote work or real estate discussions yield positive outcomes.
Kumbha.finance: Expenses related to home improvement, vehicles, or comfort are indicated. Review your asset allocation for balanced financial health.
Kumbha.relationships: Bonding with your mother or matriarchal figures brings profound emotional grounding. Express affection openly to strengthen domestic unity.
Kumbha.health: Watch out for mild chest congestion or lethargy from prolonged sitting. Practice deep Pranayama to improve oxygenation and stamina.
Kumbha.remedy: Keep a silver coin or a small vessel of clean water in the northeast of your room.

Meena.summary: Dynamic initiative and pleasant communication lead to fruitful collaborations.
Meena.general: The 3rd house transit heightens courage, proactive communication, and networking skills. You feel inspired to initiate meaningful connections and ventures.
Meena.career: Short work-related travel, marketing, and correspondence produce encouraging gains. Your persuasive pitch catches the eye of valuable partners.
Meena.finance: Favorable opportunities for incremental income arise through freelance or side projects. Prudent financial management ensures surplus capital.
Meena.relationships: Joyful interactions with siblings, cousins, and neighbors lift your spirits. An open-hearted dialogue brings clarity to your romantic bond.
Meena.health: High vitality and stamina accompany you through active pursuits. Hand and shoulder stretches will relieve work-related typing fatigue.
Meena.remedy: Chant the Gayatri Mantra 11 times during morning hours.
